parole.significato: Armenian king, particularly those of Cilician Armenia
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic تَكْفُور (takfūr), from Middle Armenian թագւոր (tʻagwor), from Old Armenian թագաւոր (tʻagawor), from Parthian *tag(a)-bar (“king”, literally “crown bearing”). Doublet of تاجور (tājwar /tâjvar, “king”).
